criterion: every changed path matches a ## Scope glob
finding: The delta edits docs/afk/small-lane/SDD.md (lines 117 and 133), but no glob in contract 0004 ## Scope names SDD.md, and D-39 widens Scope only for DIAGNOSIS-FORMAT.md.
why: /afk:execute hard rule: 'Stay inside Scope globs. If work requires going outside, stop with detail' (skills/afk/execute/SKILL.md:147). D-39 Chosen names 'the two SDD §4 "Diagnosis branch" rows' as text to edit, but its Supersedes line records a Scope addition only for the format file. Every earlier out-of-Scope edit in this plan got its own Scope entry in a Supersedes line (D-2 line 42, D-3 line 56, D-17 line 119, D-28 line 196, D-30 line 210). SDD.md is the /afk:to-sdd artifact and had no edit after it was created (git log: 8bd1d496 and then only 5781d42b), so later slices that cite SDD §4 now read text that no Scope entry covers. Inferred: the human authorized the content of the edit through D-39 Chosen; the gap is in the Scope record, not in the decision.
fix: Have the human add SDD.md (rows 'Diagnosis branch' in §4) to D-39's Scope widening, in a new ledger entry because the ledger is append-only, or revert the two SDD rows and keep the D-38-style override for the SDD.

finding: The edited format row still says the Diagnosis branch is 'made from the Base tip'. D-39 states the row now holds for a worktree that step 2 receives. For that worktree, diagnose makes no branch, and the exception lives only in the ledger (D-18), which D-39 itself rejects as a home.
why: D-39 moves the rule for a cut worktree into the shipped format file because 'the ledger is deleted with plan/ after merge, and readers of the format file never see it'. The handed-worktree exception to the same row stays ledger-only: D-18 'Supersedes: ... DIAGNOSIS-FORMAT.md "branch name from the branch template, made from the Base tip" — not for a worktree the invoker hands over'. D-39 also retargets that exception to the edited text ('D-17's and D-18's quotes of these passages now name the edited text') while it says the row 'holds ... for one step 2 receives'. These two statements conflict. After merge, a reader of the format row cannot see that a handed branch is the invoker's own branch, which diagnose does not make (SKILL.md:33 'its branch is the Diagnosis branch, and Base is that branch and its tip commit').
fix: Put the handed case into the row, for example: 'branch name of the diagnosis worktree, read from `git worktree list`; made from the Base tip when diagnose cuts the worktree, the handed branch itself otherwise'. Then add a D-39 Supersedes clause that lifts D-18's narrowing of this row, in place of the Chosen-line retarget.
evidence: DIAGNOSIS-FORMAT.md:17 '| Diagnosis branch | branch name of the diagnosis worktree, read from `git worktree list`, made from the Base tip |'; DECISIONS.md:272 'That holds for a worktree step 4 cuts and for one step 2 receives. D-17's and D-18's quotes of these passages now name the edited text.'; DECISIONS.md:126 (D-18) '... — not for a worktree the invoker hands over'
